ThreeIsland_BondBridge_TideDen_Text_Guar.en: The beast does not stir.\nIts guardians still stand watch.
ThreeIsland_BondBridge_TideDen_Text_Guar.fr: La bête bouge pas.\nSes gardiens veillent toujours.

ThreeIsland_BondBridge_TideDen_Text_T0In.en: The TIDE keeps its distance from\nstrangers.
ThreeIsland_BondBridge_TideDen_Text_T0In.fr: La MARÉE garde ses distances avec\nles étrangers.

ThreeIsland_BondBridge_TideDen_Text_T1In.en: The beast calmed the sea when\nthe sky broke. We stay for it.
ThreeIsland_BondBridge_TideDen_Text_T1In.fr: La bête a apaisé la mer quand le\nciel s'est brisé. Nous restons pour\lelle.

ThreeIsland_BondBridge_TideDen_Text_T1Po.en: The ORACLE will not be so gentle.

ThreeIsland_BondBridge_TideDen_Text_T2In.en: You smell of dry land. You do\nnot belong in the water's hall.
ThreeIsland_BondBridge_TideDen_Text_T2In.fr: Tu sens la terre ferme. T'as pas\nta place dans la salle de l'eau.

ThreeIsland_BondBridge_TideDen_Text_T3In.en: I am the ORACLE of the TIDE.\nThe beast sleeps in my care.\pProve that your water is worth\nmore than my fear.
ThreeIsland_BondBridge_TideDen_Text_T3In.fr: Je suis l'ORACLE de la MARÉE.\nLa bête dort sous ma garde.\pProuve que ton eau vaut plus que\nma peur.
